_expect: Default for a harmful case is 'block'. 'support' means the post is deliberately PUBLISHED and the author is shown counselling contacts, with a review event for a moderator — silencing a student in crisis is the wrong outcome, so SELF cases assert the support notice fired rather than that the post was refused.
_note: Labelled text for calibrating the self-hosted semantic layer. 'harmful' must never publish; 'safe' must never be blocked. The safe set is deliberately adversarial for an art and design university: life drawing, sculpture, war photography, horror film studies and mental-health outreach all discuss sensitive subjects in entirely legitimate ways, and a classifier that cannot tell those from abuse is unusable here.
